## Executive Summary

JibonFlow is a multi-tenant healthcare SaaS platform connecting patients, community health workers (CHWs), pharmacies, and pharmaceutical companies. This blueprint defines the complete system architecture covering:

- **8 Frontend Applications** (mobile + web)
- **8 Backend Microservices** (Node.js + PostgreSQL)
- **12+ External Integrations** (Agora, bKash, FHIR, AWS)
- **HIPAA/GDPR Compliance Layer** (encryption, audit, data rights)
- **4-Wave Delivery Roadmap** (28 features over 16 weeks)

**Current State**: 2 of 30 features implemented (6.7% complete)  
**Target State**: Production-ready healthcare platform with SOC2/HITRUST certification

## 1. Repository Architecture

### 1.1 Monorepo Structure (Turborepo)

```
jibonflow-platform/
├── apps/
│   ├── patient-mobile/              [✅ EXISTS] React Native/Expo
│   ├── patient-portal/              [❌ CREATE] Next.js 14 (web)
│   ├── chw-companion/               [❌ CREATE] PWA (Progressive Web App)
│   ├── provider-console/            [❌ CREATE] Next.js 14 (provider dashboard)
│   ├── pharmacy-portal/             [❌ CREATE] Next.js 14 (B2B)
│   ├── pharma-portal/               [❌ CREATE] Next.js 14 (B2B)
│   ├── admin-console/               [❌ CREATE] Next.js 14 (system admin)
│   └── marketing-site/              [❌ CREATE] Next.js 14 (landing pages)
│
├── packages/
│   ├── design-system/               [✅ PARTIAL] @jibonflow/ui (Tailwind + tokens)
│   ├── api-client/                  [❌ CREATE] @jibonflow/api (REST + GraphQL)
│   ├── fhir-utils/                  [❌ CREATE] @jibonflow/fhir (FHIR R4 helpers)
│   ├── shared-types/                [❌ CREATE] @jibonflow/types (TypeScript defs)
│   ├── i18n/                        [❌ CREATE] @jibonflow/i18n (Bangla + English)
│   ├── analytics/                   [❌ CREATE] @jibonflow/analytics (telemetry)
│   └── compliance/                  [❌ CREATE] @jibonflow/compliance (HIPAA utils)
│
├── services/
│   ├── auth-service/                [✅ EXISTS] Node.js/Express (JWT, OTP)
│   ├── patient-management-service/  [✅ EXISTS] Node.js/Express (FHIR R4)
│   ├── telemedicine-service/        [✅ EXISTS] Node.js/Express (Agora RTC)
│   ├── telemedicine-db-service/     [✅ EXISTS] Knex migrations
│   ├── payment-service/             [❌ CREATE] bKash + SSLCommerz integration
│   ├── medicine-verification/       [❌ CREATE] QR/barcode authenticity checks
│   ├── logistics-tracking/          [❌ CREATE] GPS tracking + SMS notifications
│   ├── loyalty-rewards/             [❌ CREATE] Referral + discount management
│   ├── notification-service/        [❌ CREATE] Email + SMS + Push (Twilio)
│   ├── analytics-service/           [❌ CREATE] B2B metrics + demand forecasting
│   ├── audit-logging/               [❌ CREATE] HIPAA-compliant audit trails
│   └── api-gateway/                 [❌ CREATE] Kong or AWS API Gateway
│
├── infra/
│   ├── terraform/                   [❌ CREATE] AWS ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, S3, KMS
│   ├── kubernetes/                  [❌ OPTIONAL] K8s manifests (if migrating from ECS)
│   ├── docker/                      [✅ PARTIAL] Service Dockerfiles
│   └── monitoring/                  [❌ CREATE] CloudWatch dashboards, Prometheus
│
├── scripts/
│   ├── seed-data/                   [❌ CREATE] Test data generators
│   ├── migrations/                  [✅ EXISTS] Database migrations
│   └── ci-cd/                       [❌ CREATE] GitHub Actions workflows
│
├── docs/
│   ├── api/                         [❌ CREATE] OpenAPI specs
│   ├── architecture/                [THIS FILE]
│   ├── compliance/                  [❌ CREATE] HIPAA/GDPR documentation
│   └── user-guides/                 [❌ CREATE] CHW training, pharmacy onboarding
│
├── .github/
│   └── workflows/                   [❌ CREATE] CI/CD pipelines
│
├── turbo.json                       [❌ CREATE] Turborepo configuration
├── package.json                     [✅ EXISTS] Workspace root
├── tsconfig.json                    [✅ EXISTS] TypeScript config
└── README.md                        [✅ EXISTS]
```

### 1.2 Migration Plan

**Current State**: Manual workspace with 4 backend services + 1 mobile app  
**Target State**: Turborepo monorepo with 8 apps + 12 services + 7 shared packages

**Migration Steps**:
1. Install Turborepo: `npm install turbo --global`
2. Initialize `turbo.json` with build pipelines
3. Migrate existing services to `services/` directory
4. Create missing apps in `apps/` directory
5. Extract shared code into `packages/`
6. Update all `package.json` files with workspace references
7. Set up build caching and remote caching (Vercel)
